title: Example AI note tool opens a sandbox trial

sources.text: The fictional Example Note Tool offers a sandbox trial that does not require an account.
The fictional sandbox supports Markdown export. Production data handling and pricing after the trial are not documented.

facts.claim: A sandbox trial is available without an account.
Markdown export is supported in the sandbox.

decision: Prepare a research brief and an unpublished draft; do not adopt or connect a real account.
draft: Example Note Tool's fictional sandbox is worth a small offline test. It offers an account-free trial and Markdown export. Production data handling and future pricing are unknown. This is a synthetic demonstration, not a product recommendation.
